# Copilot Instructions

When reviewing pull requests in this repository, use the
`.github/skills/code-review/SKILL.md` skill when it is relevant.

This is a public Quarto theme and extension repository for reusable Háskóli
Íslands / University of Iceland style assets. Keep reviews focused on Quarto
extension structure, SCSS/theme boundaries, website/book/RevealJS examples,
render checks, public-safe assets, design-standard attribution to
https://honnun.hi.is/, and release discipline.

Flag changes that add academic data-pipeline logic, private academic records,
credentials, MCP secrets, internal repository details, generated personal site
output, or non-synthetic examples based on real student, personnel, research,
assessment, CV, evidence, or reporting material.

Prefer actionable review comments tied to changed files and lines. Do not
require broad refactors unless the change creates a concrete public-safety,
licensing, rendering, installability, maintainability, or release risk.
